required_before_any_raw_csv_is_opened: independent acceptance of this exact request package
separate explicit user authorization for the materialization gate only
authorization recorded as a new append-only DECISIONS.md entry binding this request_id and the accepted request ZIP SHA-256
the fixed output root is absent and the storage preflight passes
the execution implementation and its guard tests are reviewed against this contract before use
approval_does_not_cover: any change to config/feature_policy.json or config/label_ontology.json

frozen_inputs.identity_rule: At execution, the CSV set, every relative path, byte size, file SHA-256, parsed header, and accepted row count must match the bundled inventory. Extra, missing, changed, duplicate-path, or duplicate-hash CSV input fails closed before output creation.

non_data_file.disposition: inventory-only; no output shard and no label

feature_and_label_files.dialect: RFC 4180 compatible comma-delimited CSV; quote character double quote; minimal deterministic quoting
feature_and_label_files.ordering: inventory relative_path bytewise ascending; source data-row order unchanged

preparation_time_observation.meaning: Observation only; it blocks authorization/execution at this location now and must be rerun immediately before any authorized execution.

disk_budget.on_cap_exceeded: abort, remove only the named staging root, publish nothing, retain a failure record outside the deterministic output root

common: Stream one source CSV at a time; never shuffle, sample, balance, impute, scale, normalize, encode, or fit anything.
Require parsed header equality with the inventory column list in its original order.
Treat every feature cell as its original CSV text value; do not trim whitespace, change case, parse-and-reformat numbers, or replace missing tokens.
Canonical CSV serialization may change quoting and line endings only; it must not change parsed cell values.
Write feature and label sidecars with identical accepted-row counts and identical source order.
No cross-dataset concatenation and no harmonised semantic core are produced.

ton_iot.feature_columns_rule: Inventory order minus the twelve unique excluded columns listed below.
ton_iot.port_decision: Drop src_port and dst_port. Do not materialize raw numeric ports and do not invent a port-class mapping in this version.
ton_iot.categorical_decision: Preserve the ten permitted native categorical columns verbatim. Do not fit or apply an encoder before splitting.
ton_iot.binary_label: label value 0 -> benign; label value 1 -> attack; any other value fails closed
ton_iot.canonical_family: exact lookup by type in the frozen ontology; missing or duplicate mapping fails closed

ciciot2023.feature_columns_rule: All 39 inventoried columns in inventory order; no added, removed, renamed, encoded, or harmonised feature.
ciciot2023.quality_exception_rule: Exclude only the three rows whose source file SHA-256, relative path, physical line, raw-line SHA-256, expected and observed field counts all match the bundled quality-exception manifest. Any mismatch fails closed.
ciciot2023.binary_label: Category directory Benign_Final -> benign; every other frozen one of the 34 mapped categories -> attack
ciciot2023.canonical_family: exact lookup by category directory in the frozen ontology
ciciot2023.capture_id: filename with the terminal .pcap.csv removed; metadata only

n_baiot.feature_columns_rule: All 115 inventoried columns in inventory order; no added, removed, renamed, encoded, or harmonised feature.
n_baiot.special_case: demonstrate_structure.csv remains inventory evidence only and produces no output shard or label.
n_baiot.binary_label: benign_traffic.csv -> benign; CSVs under gafgyt_attacks_extracted or mirai_attacks_extracted -> attack; any other path fails closed
n_baiot.source_family_and_subtype: benign/benign_traffic for benign; otherwise family directory verbatim and CSV filename stem verbatim
n_baiot.canonical_family: exact lookup by source_family and source_subtype in the frozen ontology
n_baiot.capture_id: device_id + source_family + source_subtype tuple; metadata only

row_level_provenance.model_input_boundary: All provenance is outside feature CSVs and is forbidden as model input.
row_level_provenance.row_mapping: For each shard, output data row k (1-based, excluding header) maps to the kth non-excluded source data row. In this version every exclusion is a registered final CICIoT2023 row, so accepted output row k maps directly to source_row k. The ledger records the exact excluded physical/source row positions.
row_level_provenance.source_row_definition: 1-based data record index after the source header
row_level_provenance.shard_id: four-digit file ordinal plus first 16 hexadecimal characters of the frozen source-file SHA-256

live feature policy and ontology match the accepted SHA-256 values and frozen statuses
all three inventory and required census/quality-exception artifacts match their pinned SHA-256 values
source CSV sets and every inventoried identity field match exactly
output and staging roots do not exist and do not overlap any source root
free bytes at the output filesystem meet the minimum
materialization is the only authorized operation
postconditions: 399 feature shards and 399 label shards are present; the zero-row N-BaIoT structure file has no shard
accepted rows are exactly TON-IoT 211043, CICIoT2023 46776697, N-BaIoT 7062606, total 54050346
every feature/label pair has identical row count and deterministic shard identity
feature counts are exactly TON-IoT 32, CICIoT2023 39, N-BaIoT 115
TON-IoT binary/subtype counts match the bundled frozen census
CICIoT2023 and N-BaIoT per-source counts and label derivations reconcile to their frozen inventories and ontology mappings

validation.publication_rule: Publish by one same-filesystem atomic rename only after every postcondition passes. A verifier exit other than zero prohibits publication.

failure_handling.cleanup_scope: Only the exact staging root named in this request may be removed after identity and path containment checks.
failure_handling.input_or_schema_mismatch: abort before publication; do not repair or normalize the input
failure_handling.unexpected_label_or_path: abort before publication; require a new reviewed request version
failure_handling.disk_exhaustion_or_budget_breach: abort, remove only staging, leave final root absent
failure_handling.interrupt: abort, remove only staging, leave final root absent
failure_handling.failure_record: Record phase, check, exception class, and hashes already observed; never include raw row contents or secrets.
failure_handling.retry: No automatic retry. Diagnose, issue a new reviewable request revision if the contract changes, and obtain fresh explicit authorization.

implementation_boundary.reason: This package is the materialization-only execution application and deterministic contract. An executor must be implemented and reviewed against it but must not be run before separate authorization.
permitted_pre_authorization_actions: run the package-only verifier and synthetic tests
prepare an executor that cannot read raw CSVs without a separate authorization record
forbidden_pre_authorization_actions: open or hash raw CSVs for execution preflight
create the output or staging root
